comment: Hardware checks for the pull-request gate. A rule applies when a module or FFS file matching one of its `match` globs changed beyond the stack cookie, was added or removed, or changed its DEPEX; `when` rules apply on fvdiff conditions. Commands run on the Orion O6 after flashing the head build.

always.title: Every flash
checks: Before flashing: have Radxa's official image with `FlashUpdate.efi` or an SPI programmer ready to restore the previous firmware.
Cold boot (power removed) and warm reboot reach the OS: `journalctl -b -p err --no-pager` shows no new firmware-related errors compared with the previous image.

when.title: PCR0 prediction
checks: `cat /sys/class/tpm/tpm0/pcr-sha256/0` equals the head build's predicted value (case-insensitive): `{pcr0_sha256}`.
Update anything that seals to PCR0 (disk unlock policies) before rebooting into the new image.

when.title: FV file set, order or DEPEX changed
checks: Explain every added, removed or reordered FFS file and DEPEX change in the pull request.
Firmware setup opens (Esc at the logo) and the boot manager lists the expected entries.

when.title: FV capacity
checks: FVMAIN_COMPACT has {compact_free} bytes free (base {compact_free_base}); the FD stays 0x1f0000. Below 16 KiB free, plan space before taking more upstream code.

rules.title: Measured boot, TPM gate and physical presence
checks: `cat /sys/class/tpm/tpm0/pcr-sha256/0` equals the predicted PCR0 of the head build.

Event log replays: `nix shell nixpkgs#tpm2-tools -c sudo tpm2_eventlog /sys/kernel/security/tpm0/binary_bios_measurements | tail -n 30` lists PCR0 with the FVMAIN measurement before the separator, and its computed PCR0 matches the value above.
`dmesg | grep -i tpm` shows the firmware TPM probed without errors and `ls /dev/tpm0 /dev/tpmrm0` exist.
TPM boot gate: the board still refuses to boot to the OS when the TPM is unavailable (if you can provoke it safely), and boots normally otherwise.

Physical presence: in firmware setup, TCG2 configuration, request a TPM clear, reboot; the prompt appears and only F12 confirms. Press Esc to reject and check the TPM was not cleared (`cat /sys/class/tpm/tpm0/pcr-sha256/7` unchanged, sealed secrets still unseal).

rules.title: Setup, boot options and setup variables
checks: Firmware setup opens, saves and keeps settings across a reboot; boot order is unchanged.
Setup variables stay NV|BS: compare `ls /sys/firmware/efi/efivars` before and after flashing; no new platform setup variable appears (runtime-visible variables would).

rules.title: USB
checks: Cold boot (power removed) and warm reboot: the keyboard works in firmware setup and the boot menu on every port you use.
After each boot `lsusb -t` lists the same devices as before flashing; `dmesg | grep -iE 'xhci|usb .*(error|fail)'` shows no new errors.
Boot from a USB stick from the boot manager.

rules.title: PCIe and storage
checks: `lspci -tv` matches the tree from before flashing; the NVMe boot disk is found by the firmware and the OS.
`dmesg | grep -iE 'pcie|aer'` shows no new link or AER errors.

rules.title: ACPI tables
checks: `sudo dmesg | grep -iE 'ACPI (BIOS )?(Error|Warning)|AE_[A-Z_]+|firmware bug'` shows nothing new.
`ls /sys/firmware/acpi/tables` lists the same tables as before; `nix shell nixpkgs#acpica-tools -c sudo acpidump -b` then `iasl -d dsdt.dat` disassembles cleanly.
SMMU policy unchanged: `dmesg | grep -i smmu` and `ls /sys/kernel/iommu_groups | wc -l` match the previous image for the selected SMMU setting; ACPI remains the default boot description.
Devices described by ACPI still bind: `lspci`, network, audio and `ls /sys/bus/platform/devices | wc -l` unchanged.

rules.title: Early boot, clocks and reset
checks: Have the SPI programmer connected or at hand: a fault here can stop the board before the boot menu.
Serial console shows PrePi and DXE start; `reboot` and `poweroff` work; RTC time survives a power cycle (`timedatectl`).

rules.title: Flash and variables
checks: Confirm no new SPI flash writer was added (review the diff of the module).
UEFI variables persist: `sudo efibootmgr -v` before and after a reboot; `efivar -l | wc -l` sane.
Raw FlashUpdate recovery still works with Radxa's official image (only when you can afford the reflash).

rules.title: Secure Boot and crypto
checks: `mokutil --sb-state` reports the expected state; `efi-readvar` lists the expected PK/KEK/db.
Signed boot chain still boots with Secure Boot enabled (if used).

rules.title: Display and consoles
checks: Logo and firmware setup appear on the monitor you use (HDMI/DP) and on the serial console.

rules.title: Network boot
checks: If you use network boot: PXE/HTTP boot entries appear and fetch a test image; otherwise confirm the OS network works.
